title: Compute electronic density of states from tight-binding model
action: Compute the electronic density of states N(E) for the anisotropic tight-binding band E(k) = ε0 - 2t(cos k_x a + cos k_y a) - 2γt cos k_z a for the required γ values (0, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0). Use the standard approach of integrating over the Brillouin zone (e.g., via the imaginary part of the Green function). The resulting N(E) data must be available for the subsequent Tc calculation.
description: This intermediate stage computes the energy-dependent density of states that is required as input to the BCS gap equation. The agent must implement this integration itself; no pre-computed DOS is provided.

title: Solve BCS gap equation and compute isotope exponent
action: Using the computed density of states N(E), numerically solve the BCS gap equation (the integral equation for the transition temperature Tc) as a function of the Fermi-level deviation δ = E_F - ε_0 for each γ value. For each solution, compute the isotope effect exponent α via numerical differentiation of ln(Tc) with respect to ln(ħω_c). Record all (γ, δ, Tc, α) combinations in results.csv.
description: This is the main scored artifact. It contains the Tc and α values for the specified conditions, which are the primary quantities to reproduce and verify.
output_schema: CSV with columns: gamma (float, dimensionless), delta (float, in eV), Tc (float, in K), alpha (float, dimensionless). The file must include rows for gamma in {0, 0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0} at delta=0, and for gamma=0 and gamma=1 a set of delta values covering the range [-0.2, 0.2] eV with a step size no larger than 0.01 eV.
